title: Loose stone samples tested in Israel turn out to be basalt

tellings.quote: And basalt, volcanic stones they found.

plain: In 2012, loose stones taken from the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea, were tested in Israel and found to be basalt, a volcanic rock. A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, who was involved in exploring the site, relays the result as he was told it: "basalt, volcanic stones they found." The finding matters because it bears on what the object on the seafloor is made of.
